scenario.name: US tariff on EU spirits (25%)
scenario.description: A 25% US import tariff on EU-origin spirits, against the WTO-bound zero they normally enter at. The US is the most exposed market in the portfolio because ex-works is the largest share of its shelf price, so the tariff has less existing tax to hide behind.
